name: Kanto
description: The cradle of Pokémon research and home to Professor Oak's laboratory. Characterized by rural routes, winding cycling roads, coastal ports, and the bustling urban core of Saffron City.

name: Johto
description: A historic and spiritually rooted land steeped in mythology, pagodas, and ancient towers. Revered for its deep connection to the legendary birds Ho-Oh and Lugia.

name: Hoenn
description: An ecologically vibrant, tropical archipelago abundant with lush nature, an active volcano, expansive oceanic dive trenches, and dramatic weather patterns.

name: Sinnoh
description: A mountainous, snow-kissed northern region crowned by the sacred Mt. Coronet. Deeply tied to the creation legends of time, space, and antimatter.

name: Hisui
description: The untamed wilderness of Sinnoh in an ancient era before towns or gym leagues existed. A perilous frontier where people and wild Pokémon lived in cautious separation.

name: Unova
realWorldInspiration: New York metropolitan area, United States
description: A bustling, cosmopolitan center featuring massive suspension bridges, soaring skyscrapers in Castelia City, amusement parks, and four dynamic rotating seasons.

name: Kalos
description: A star-shaped realm celebrating high fashion, art, romance, and culinary elegance, centered around the radiant Prism Tower of Lumiose City and the dawn of Mega Evolution.

name: Alola
description: A tropical paradise consisting of four natural islands and one artificial preserve. Known for its sacred Guardian Deities, Totem Pokémon Island Trials, and joyous lifestyle.

name: Galar
description: An industrialized land with sprawling countryside hills, quaint brick cottages, modern steam-powered cities, and immense sports-stadium Gyms hosting Dynamax battles.

name: Paldea
description: A vast, boundless open-world territory crowned by prestigious academies and centered around the mysterious, crystal-veiled depths of the Great Crater (Area Zero).
